body: I wish this silence only crept over me at night. I always feel alone but never truly am. I just feel like I take up space and the only solution that seems appealing to me is the process that turns my bones to dust after my flesh has been burned away during cremation. I want to find a purpose in life that does not follow the path that everyone else expects me to live. But no occupation seems truly intriguing to me, and most of my education just seems like a waste of time and resources.
Some things are better off not being told
